eyebrow: Same tool, same pattern, new trigger
code:
Catalog Automation:
  catalog request -> Ask for Approval -> Stage 2 -> ...

Change Enablement:
  change_request -> Ask for Approval -> Stage 2 -> ...

  Same Flow Designer action.
  Same sequential chaining.
caption: The multi-stage pattern carries over directly.

steps.label: Stage 1: Manager approval
steps.sub: runs for every Normal change, regardless of risk

steps.label: Branch on risk
steps.sub: Low -> move to Scheduled | Medium/High -> add Stage 2

steps.label: Stage 2: CAB approval
steps.sub: only triggers for Medium or High risk changes

code:
After manager approval resolves:

  If change_request.risk == Low
      -> move toward Scheduled
  Else (Medium or High)
      -> start CAB approval stage
caption: A real branch in the flow — not a policy someone has to remember.

steps.label: Approved
steps.sub: flow continues to the next stage or to Scheduled

steps.label: Rejected
steps.sub: record routes back for rework, or is marked rejected

steps.label: Never
steps.sub: a record silently stalled with no next step

subtitle: The real recurring body behind the CAB approval stage.
